notes.title: Deadly Desire 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello fellow gamers!
Yo boi xXx_DarkSlayer420_xXx is here with new update for Your favourite game - Deadly Desire!

Me and my team tried really hard to fix all the (skill) issues we had, including those in Deadly Desire and we are excited to announce that there is also new goated content for you all to enjoy, no cap!
Remôta DLC had to be postponed due to issues in main content of the game, we are doing it the AAA developer way.


Bug fixes:
-Added third person camera in Acquitted mission cause it was literally unplayable even on empty stomach
-removed ability to save in home because of bugs, making it useless (use save game feature in the menu)
-you can now touch Feet (Pub on Fromfightrow street) and garbage cans
-removed Inspect feature for all guns, but they are still pretty
-if you run out of bullets in shoot out, community comes together and gives you some more like in good old days, aint that right
-more than doubled maximum amount of ammo you can get in Gunshirdawg
-you will not be teleported to Morewino after searching for jobs
-Morewino school entrance hill slightly lowered so gun trucks can get out of their parking lot
-Game should run at normal speed after resetting even if you drank TTRT tea (including one in the game)
-you can pick up only one garbage bag at the time (it is not a bug, it is a feature)
-garbage truck doors can be opened only from inside the vehicle
-Gaspar BUFFED slightly due to community demands
-cameras in museum now have a purpose
-Podium at the Miners Square has the collision now
-pointers added at the places where literally every player got stuck at


New content:
-due to huge community demand we added new garbage truck missions
-1 additional post delivery mission
-2 parkours
-Haluwa experienced baby boom and now there is little bit more people


Known issues (not yet resolved): 
-car physics/control is sometimes little delayed
-everybody is like a stone (I'll wait for you there...good song)
-sniper is still pacifist
-walking still sounds weird outside of the city because it is out of our jurisdiction
-you still cant pick up Climbies and other stuff from the ground, it is not sanitary
-entrance to Terrels flat is still kind of weird
-half of the city is sometimes still dead lmao
-my mental health
-hospital doors are still teleports cause fixing would be hard
-landfill is not on map cause we cant highlight whole city, but directions were added
-still no support and optimalization for slow computers (like macs)
-cars still get stuck under the bridge near railway station because i fixed wrong spot
-city still acts weird during credits cause it does not want to let you go in the end (it does not even matter)
-subtitles still not added despite community requests
-and many more

We hope you enjoy this update, let us know what should we add in the next update!
